The ability Wind Rider activates when the User is sent in.
The ability Aerilate gains +1 Damage Dice.
The ability Cloud Nine removes Weather-Types instead of nullifying them.
Moves Affected: The Move Camouflage changes the User’s type to Flying.
The Move Nature Power becomes Aero Blast.
The Moves Terrain Pulse and Embody Element become Flying-Type.
The effects of the Move Tailwind last for 8 turns.
The Move Sky Drop gains 4 chance Dice to OHKO grounded Pokémon.
The Moves Hurricane and Thunder gain Never Miss.
The Move Dive gains the Flying Sub-Type.
Changing The Field-Type: The Moves Gravity, Smack Down, Grav Apple and Thousand Arrows change the Field-Type to Mountainous.

General Effects: Ground, Water and Gras-Type attacks gain +1 Damage Dice.
Grassy Terrain, Rain Weather last 8 turns.
At the end of each Round the dexterity of grounded Active Combatants decreases by 1.
Pokémon with the abilities Quick Feet, Gooey, Bubble Vision, Liquid Ooze, Clear Body, Swift Swim and Propeller Tail are immune to this effect.
All Moves effected by the Damp ability fail to activate.
Abilities Affected: The ability Mimicry changes the User’s type to Grass.
The abilities Gooey and Swampound’s effects are increased by 1.
Pokémon with the Dry Skin ability heal 1HP at the end of each Round.
Moves Affected: The Move Camouflage changes the User’s type to Ground.
Nature Power becomes Muddy Water.
The Moves Terrain Pulse and Embody Element become Ground-Type.
The Moves Muddy Water, Mud Shot, Mud Slap, Mud Bomb, have no reduced accuracy and
gain +1 Damage Dice.
The Moves Strength Sap, Leech Life, Absorb, Mega Drain and Giga Drain heal for the total stat reduction / Damage dealt.
Changing The Field-Type: The Moves Acid Rain, Pollution, Sludge Bomb, Sludge Wave and Acid Downpour change the Field-Type to Murkwater.

General Effects: Bug, Dark, Electric, Normal, Poison and Steel-Type attacks gain +1 additional Damage Dice.
Fairy-Type attacks get -1 Damage Dice.
Abilities Affected: The ability Mimicry changes the User’s type to Dark.
The abilities Merciless, Toxic Boost, activate when the User is sent out.
The abilities Poison Point, Stench and Effect Spore have their chance Dice increased to 5.
The ability Adaptability’s effect is doubled.
The ability Download’s boost is doubled.
The abilities Anticipation, Early Bird, Frisk, Pick Pocket and Unnerve boost Dexterity, Strength and Special by 1.
Moves Affected: The Move Camouflage changes the User’s type to Normal.
The Move Nature Power becomes Smog.
The Moves Terrain Pulse and Embody Element become Steel-Type.
The Moves Beat Up, Pay Day, Smog, Steamroller, Techno Blast gain +1 Damage Dice.
The Move Smokescreen lowers accuracy by 2.
The Move Recycle additionally boosts a random stat.
The Move Shift Gear increases Strength by 2.
The Move Autotomize increases Dexterity by 2.

General Effects: Ultra Beasts gain +1 Damage Dice to their Moves.
Beast Balls gain +2 Dice to their seal checks.
A chosen or random terrain or Weather-Type activates at the start of the battle.

1D10: 1. Electric Terrain, 2. Grassy Terrain, 3. Misty Terrain, 4. Psychic Terrain, 5. Snowy Terrain, 6. Sunny Weather, 7. Rain Weather, 8. Acid Rain Weather, 9. Midnight Weather, 10. Sandstorm Weather.
Abilities Affected: The ability Mimicry changes the User’s type to whichever Terrain or Weather is active.
The ability Beast Boost does not suffer from a limit of times it can activate.
Moves Affected: The Move Camouflage changes the User’s type to whichever Terrain or Weather is active.
Nature Power becomes a signature Move of an Ultra Beast (At the Storytellers discretion).
The Moves Terrain Pulse and Embody Element become the type of whichever Terrain or Weather is active.

General Effects: Non Water-Types Dexterity is halved (rounded down). Except for Pokémon with Swift Swim.
Fire-Type Moves fail to activate.
Physical Moves used by non Water-Types get -2 Damage Dice.
Ground-Type attacks gain the Water Sub-Type.
Weather effects fail to activate.
Electric-Type attacks gain +2 Damage Dice.
Abilities Affected: The ability Mimicry changes the User’s type to Water.
The abilities Torrent, Hydration, Swift Swim and Schooling activate when the User is sent out.
Pokémon with the abilities Flame Body and Magma Armor take 2 Damage at the end of the Round.
The ability Water Veil gives immunity to all Status Conditions.
Pokémon with the ability Water Absorb heal for 1HP at the end of the Round.
Moves Affected: The Move Camouflage changes the User’s type to Fire.
The Move Nature Power becomes Water Pulse.
The Moves Terrain Pulse and Embody Element become Water-Type.
The Moves Anchor Shot and Dragon Darts gain +1 Damage Dice.
The Move Whirpool deals 4 Damage Dice at the end of the Round.
The Move Dive loses its charge phase and gains Never Miss.
Changing The Field-Type: The Moves Dive, Bounce, Fly, Sky Drop and Shore Up change the Field-Type to Aquatic.
The Moves Pollution, Sludge Wave and Acid Downpour change the Field-Type to Murkwater.

General Effects: Grounded non Fire or Rock-Type Pokémon take 1 Fire Damage at the end of the Round.
Pokémon with the abilities Magma Armor, Flame Body, Flash Fire, Flare Boost, White Smoke, Water Veil, Heatproof and Heat Exchange are immune to this effect.
Active Combatants cannot become Frozen/Frostbitten.
Fire, Ground and Rock-Type attacks gain +1 Damage Dice.
Grass, Ice and Water-Type attacks (except Seed Bomb, Solar Beam, Solar Blade, Scald, Hydro Steam and Steam Eruption) get -1 Damage Dice.
Hail Weather fails to activate.
Pokémon who have used the Move Burn Up regain their Fire typing at the end of the Round.
Abilities Affected: The ability Mimicry changes the User’s type to Fire.
Pokémon with the ability Dry Skin take 1 Damage at the end of the Round.
The abilities Blaze, Flash Fire, and Flare Boost activate when the User is sent in.
Pokémon with the ability Flame Body heal 1HP at the end of the Round.
The ability Ice Face melts upon entry.
Moves Affected: The Move Camouflage changes the User’s type to Fire.
The Move Nature Power becomes Lava Plume.
The Moves Terrain Pulse and Embody Element become Fire-Type.
The Moves Smog and Clear Smog gain the Fire Sub-Type.
The Move Aqua Ring prevents Damage from the Field-Type.
The Moves Scald, Hydro Steam and Steam Eruption gain +1 Damage Dice.
The Move Stealth Rock’s Damage changes to Fire-Type.
Changing The Field-Type: If Rain Weather is active for 8 rounds the Field-Type changes to Mountainous.
After 2 uses the Moves Surf and Muddy Water change the Field-Type to Mountainous.
